items.title: Wheat Corner Spray
items.alt: Three golden wheat heads on curved stems form an open L-shaped corner with narrow dry leaves.
items.description: Three golden wheat heads on curved stems form an open L-shaped corner with narrow dry leaves. Place this open corner at the edge of a personal card without covering the wheat tips.

items.title: Wheat Wax Seal
items.alt: A burgundy wax seal has an impressed wheat-ear motif beside a brass seal stamp with a wooden handle and one ripe wheat head.
items.description: A burgundy wax seal has an impressed wheat-ear motif beside a brass seal stamp with a wooden handle and one ripe wheat head. The impressed ear motif suits a personal stationery or sealing-wax layout.

items.title: Wrapped Wheat and Lavender Bouquet
items.alt: A small bouquet of golden wheat heads and lavender sprigs is wrapped in folded navy paper and tied with twine.
items.description: A small bouquet of golden wheat heads and lavender sprigs is wrapped in folded navy paper and tied with twine. Use the compact wrapped flowers on a personal thank-you card or seasonal invitation.

items.title: Gift Parcel with Wheat
items.alt: A complete kraft-paper parcel has a rust-colored fabric bow with one wheat ear tucked into its knot.
items.description: A complete kraft-paper parcel has a rust-colored fabric bow with one wheat ear tucked into its knot. The complete parcel works as an isolated detail in a personal gift-planning page.

items.title: Embroidered Wheat Brooch
items.alt: An oval cream felt brooch with navy backing shows stitched golden wheat heads beside a separate navy felt oval with a closed pin.
items.description: An oval cream felt brooch with navy backing shows stitched golden wheat heads beside a separate navy felt oval with a closed pin. The visible stitches and pin backing suit a small sewing-craft vocabulary card.

items.title: Pressed Wheat in a Nature Journal
items.alt: An open blank brown-bound notebook has one pressed wheat stalk attached by two cream paper strips, with a pencil beside it.
items.description: An open blank brown-bound notebook has one pressed wheat stalk attached by two cream paper strips, with a pencil beside it. The blank facing page leaves room for a personal plant observation or caption.
